name: herdr-editor
description: An editable file editor pane for the Herdr desktop app

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.files.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.coverage: mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout && se-gates qg coverage-receipt
